# Cohort and demographics {#demographics}

Age and sex from the metadata columns set under `columns` in
`report_config.yml`.

- **Unpaired comparisons** (different subjects in the two groups): age is
  compared with a Welch t-test and a Wilcoxon rank-sum test, sex with Fisher's
  exact test.
- **Paired comparisons** (the same subjects at two timepoints): both groups are
  the same people, so no test applies.

The cohort table counts subjects once; the per-comparison tables count samples.

## Cohort overview

```{r, results='asis'}
cat(cohort_table(book))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
for (cmp in book$comparisons) {
  cat(cmp_heading(cmp, 2, "demo"))
  cat(demographics_table(cmp), "\n\n")
  cat(demographics_tests(cmp), "\n\n")
  cat(age_plot(cmp), "\n\n")
}
```
